name: Glowing Manuscript Treehouse Library
description: Deep inside a colossal redwood, a hidden library blooms from its roots, with ancient books suspended in amber light.
prompt: A colossal redwood tree with hollowed trunk revealing an interior library; shelves of glowing manuscripts float in warm amber light, vines and bioluminescent spores fill the space, shafts of sunlight beam through leaf gaps, magical realism style, hyperrealistic lighting, intricate details.
caption: Discover the stories that grow inside the oldest trees 🌳📚✨
